item.title: What to know about joint US-Nigeria operation that killed a senior militant leader
item.description: President Donald Trump says a joint U.S. and Nigerian operation has killed a top Islamic State leader in Nigeria

item.title: Former mayor shot dead in central Colombia during election campaign
item.description: A former mayor allied with presidential candidate Abelardo de La Espriella was shot dead in Colombia’s heartland, local authorities say

item.title: At least 4 people killed in one of the largest Ukrainian drone strikes on Russia
item.description: At least four people, including three near Moscow, died in one of the largest Ukrainian overnight attacks against Russia since the start of the war, according to Russian local authorities
